journeys.title: Discovery — home → menu → categories → a category → a book
journeys.failureMode: menu unreachable; category title unreadable; cover missing; any horizontal scroll

steps.name: 1. / renders with no horizontal scroll
2. menu trigger is on screen and >= 44x44
3. the drawer opens and offers browse destinations
4. tapping Categories navigates there
5. /categories: no horizontal scroll
6. category titles are >= 12px and none is clipped
7. tapping a category opens /categories/classics-and-philosophy
8. the category title is present, sized and not clipped
9. /categories/*: no horizontal scroll
10. tapping a book opens /books/puzzles-old-and-new
11. the cover actually decoded

detail.alt: Cover of Puzzles Old and New

steps.name: 12. the book title is present
13. book detail: no horizontal scroll

journeys.title: Purchase — ebooks → a direct-sale book → cart → quantity → checkout
journeys.failureMode: price or CTA below the fold; quantity control untappable; return lands on an error

steps.name: 0. the cart starts empty
1. /ebooks renders with no horizontal scroll
2a. tapping a card opens the popup
2. the popup's Full details opens /books/pencil-and-paper
3. the price is readable without scrolling
4. the Add button is above the fold and >= 44px tall
5. the Add control responds to a tap
6. the header cart control opens /cart
7. the cart shows the line just added
8. the button's claim matches the cart
9. adjust the quantity
steps.detail: not applicable: a digital line has an implicit quantity of 1 by design (src/lib/cart.ts), so no quantity control exists to test.

steps.name: 10. the remove control is labelled and clears 44px
11. tapping remove actually removes the line
12. the line's Buy control is present and >= 44px tall
13. Paddle overlay → return → /order/[id] → /account/library
steps.detail: stops here deliberately: completing checkout means a real payment-provider transaction, and the brief forbids faking one. Paddle is also not keyed in this environment, so a tap would only surface a configuration error, not the reader's experience.

steps.name: 14. /cart: no horizontal scroll

journeys.title: Amazon + companion — an Amazon-listed book → its companion → a sheet → signup
journeys.failureMode: a buy CTA appears for a book not sold here; sheet fails; signup input collapsed

steps.name: 1. no published book offers a buy CTA without a price
2. an Amazon-only book (/books/the-tricksters-table) hides the direct-buy CTA
steps.detail: its page offers Amazon and no direct Add

steps.name: 3. the Amazon CTAs are >= 44px tall
4. the companion link reaches /companion/world-games
5. the companion offers at least one sheet
6. every download control is >= 44px tall
7. the sheet downloads and is a real PDF
8. the signup input is not collapsed (>= 200px wide, >= 44px tall)
9. the companion page: no horizontal scroll

journeys.title: Search — tap search → type "games" → results visible → tap one
journeys.failureMode: keyboard covers the results; results below the fold; result tap does nothing

steps.name: 1. the header search control opens /search
2. the search input is present and not collapsed
3. the search input clears the 12px floor
steps.detail: 15px (iOS would zoom below 16px — untested, no iOS device)

steps.name: 4. pressing Enter runs the search
5. the search returns results
6. the first result is on screen when the results land
steps.detail: first result at 477px of 719px (keyboard dismissed by submit, as Android does)

steps.name: 7. the first result with the soft keyboard still raised
steps.detail: modelled only: a 45%-height IME would start at 395px and the first result is at 477px. CDP cannot raise the real IME, so this is checked by hand — see MOBILE_REGRESSION_SUITE.md section 3.

steps.name: 8. tapping the first result opens /books/weather-permitting
9. the result page: no horizontal scroll
